# Archived workflows

These upstream workflows are retained as reference outside `.github/workflows/`.
They are not scheduled or manually runnable in this checkout. Use `job_search.py`
for the local workflow. Some archived files explicitly force-add scraped results
or publish generated data: review them before restoring any workflow.

Moving these files locally does not disable workflows already present on GitHub
until the change is committed and pushed. The remote repository was not modified.
